summary: Fixed the build report sometimes never loading and hardened swamp CLI calls. (1) lib/swamp.ts: runSwamp() now passes { timeout: 20_000, killSignal: 'SIGKILL' } to execFile; a stuck swamp CLI call is killed after 20s and parseCliError() detects the resulting killed+SIGKILL error and throws SwampCliError('swamp CLI call timed out') instead of the generic exec error, so every route's existing SwampCliError handling now also catches hangs. (2) Simplified the report-resolution chain: deleted the report-omarchy-package-dossier-json version-walk (walkDossierVersions/getDossierJsonRow/getDossierMarkdownRow/parseDossierContent/DOSSIER_VERSION_LOOKBACK) since durable per-package dossiers (packager data dossier-<pkgname>-<version>, already fetched first by the route) cover the retained case and the walked version history isn't durably retained anyway. getBuildReport() now goes straight from the current @omarchy/package-dossier report-get (accepted only on pkgname match, for a just-built package racing the durable-dossier write) to the evidence fallback; getEvidenceFallback's three packager data gets (lint/audit/build) now run via Promise.all instead of sequentially. Worst-case swamp invocations for the report chain itself (durable dossier + report-get + 3 evidence gets) is 5, matching the target. (3) components/package-request/build-report-section.tsx: added an AbortController with a 30s client-side timeout on the report fetch (aborted on unmount/pkgname change too), and replaced the silent-forever loading state on error with a message plus a Retry button (shadcn Button) that resets state and re-triggers the effect via an attempt counter.
notes: npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build, and npm run lint all pass. Rewrote the getBuildReport tests in lib/swamp.test.ts to drop version-walk coverage and add: (a) durable-dossier-first / current-report-match case, (b) evidence fallback on report mismatch, (c) a test that proves the three evidence gets are issued concurrently (via Promise.all) rather than sequentially by parking their callbacks unresolved and flushing microtasks until all three have fired, (d) a dedicated 'swamp CLI timeout handling' describe block covering the killed+SIGKILL -> SwampCliError('swamp CLI call timed out') path, the execFile timeout/killSignal options being passed through, and non-timeout errors still parsing normally. Updated route.test.ts's two report-chain tests to the new (shorter) call sequence and added a route-level timeout-propagation test (expects the 500+ status swampErrorResponse falls back to for an unrecognized message). No component-level test was added for build-report-section.tsx since this repo's vitest config only runs *.test.ts under a node environment (no jsdom/RTL setup for .tsx component tests) -- consistent with the rest of the codebase, which has no existing component tests either.
